auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: PASSWORD (username/password) or TOKEN (key-based authentication)

client_id.description: Client ID for token authentication (required for TOKEN authentication)

host.description: Workday Adaptive host URL, including the scheme, required for TOKEN authentication

instance_code.description: Instance code for Workday Adaptive Planning.

isu.description: Integration System User (ISU) for token authentication (required for TOKEN authentication)

login.description: User email address (required for PASSWORD authentication)

private_key.description: PEM-formatted PKCS#8 private key, including BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY markers, for token authentication

account_sync_mode.description: Account sync mode for the table. Options: `SYNC_ALL_ACCOUNTS` (sync all accounts) or `SELECT_SPECIFIC_ACCOUNTS` (sync selected accounts only).

currency.description: List of currencies to sync for the table, if applicable.

dimensions.description: List of dimensions to sync for the table, if applicable.

include_zero_rows.description: Include zero rows in the table sync.

level_sync_mode.description: Level sync mode for the table. Options: `SYNC_ALL_LEVELS` (sync all levels) or `SELECT_SPECIFIC_LEVELS` (sync selected levels only).

selected_accounts.description: List of account IDs to sync when `accountSyncMode` is `SELECT_SPECIFIC_ACCOUNTS`. Each ID should be in the format: `<accountId>,<isAssumption>` (e.g., `1,false`).

selected_levels.description: List of level IDs to sync when `levelSyncMode` is `SELECT_SPECIFIC_LEVELS`.

sync_descendant_accounts.description: Flag to indicate if descendant accounts should be included for the selected accounts.

sync_descendant_levels.description: Flag to indicate if descendant levels should be included for the selected levels.

version_sync_strategy.description: Version sync strategy for the table, `SYNC_ALL_AND_NEW_VERSIONS` or `SYNC_SELECT_VERSIONS`.

versions.description: List of versions to sync for the table, if versionSyncStrategy is `SYNC_SELECT_VERSIONS`.
